zh.title: 采数据打标签
zh.summary: 搜集了货架上的物体的照片，大概有两百多张，然后来打标签用于训练yolo模型，后面做视觉检测。

en.title: Collecting and Annotating Training Data
en.summary: I collected more than 200 images of products on supermarket shelves and annotated them to build a dataset for training a YOLO object detection model, laying the groundwork for the vision perception module used in subsequent grasping tasks.
